name: pixels
purpose: A grey image of a list of rows of numbers, one square per cell, for example the rows of a field. It only shows. The ramp goes from the page colour at the smallest value to the text colour at the largest.

bind.doc: the state key of the rows

label.doc: what the image shows, above it and for screen readers; {path} takes a state value

lo.doc: the value at the page colour; the smallest value if left out

hi.doc: the value at the text colour; the largest value if left out

size.doc: the width of the image in pixels
